headlines.text: Looking back to 2023, when Kris Statlander vs. Taya Valkyrie clashed for the AEW TBS Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 5.75. It was the 20th time the AEW TBS Title had been on the line, a nice marker in that championship's story. A hard-fought battle for the gold.
Flash back to 2025, when ProtoShita kicked off their AEW journey as a team, appearing on Collision, rated 7.05 ? a solid showing.
On this day in 2024, Komander & Metalik touched down in AEW for the first time as a team, appearing on Rampage, rated 6.08.

secondaries.text: Looking back to 2023, when AEW welcomed Garcia & Sabre Jr. for the first time as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.12 ? a well-worked match.
Turning the clock back to 2023: Andretti, Darius & Fox made their AEW debut as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.72.
It was 2024 when Willow Nightingale vs. Serena Deeb met in an Owen Hart Tournament Match, in the show-closing main event slot on Rampage, rated 6.58.
